ytui can now uninstall itself, and has a website with full docs: https://bong-water-water-bong.github.io/ytui/

## Download

| Platform | Package | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `ytui-v2026.10.17-windows-x86_64.zip` | Includes libmpv. Unzip and run `ytui.exe` in **Windows Terminal**. |
| Linux (x86_64) | `ytui-v2026.10.17-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Install libmpv (`libmpv2` / `mpv-libs`) for the mpv engine. |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `ytui-v2026.10.17-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `brew install mpv` for the mpv engine. |

You also need `yt-dlp`, `ffmpeg` and a JavaScript runtime (`deno` or Node.js) on your PATH. On Windows: `winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp Gyan.FFmpeg DenoLand.Deno`.

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's new

- **`ytui --uninstall`:** signs you out of Google, then removes ytui's settings, data and cache, and ytui itself.
  - It lists everything first and asks before deleting. `--yes` skips the question.
  - Run from the unpacked release folder, it also removes the files that came with it.
  - yt-dlp, ffmpeg and mpv stay installed.
- **Website and docs:** install guides for each system, render modes, pixel graphics, playback, sign-in, keys,
  command-line options, troubleshooting, and a step-by-step guide to watching YouTube in the terminal, including over SSH and in tmux.
- **Fix:** `--help` now shows the right `--gfx-px` defaults (960 px over SSH, 1920 px on your own computer).

The bundled `libmpv-2.dll` is mpv (GPL), built by shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake. Its licences and source links are in `third-party/mpv/`.
